description: This file defines the EntityDisplayRepository class in Drupal, responsible for managing entity display configurations such as view modes and form modes, including caching, retrieval, and options handling.

classes.name: EntityDisplayRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing entity display configurations such as view modes and form modes in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies: entity type manager, module handler, cache backend, and language manager.

methods.name: getAllViewModes
methods.description: Returns all view modes for entities.

methods.name: getViewModes
methods.description: Returns view modes for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getAllFormModes
methods.description: Returns all form modes for entities.

methods.name: getFormModes
methods.description: Returns form modes for a specific entity type.

methods.name: getAllDisplayModesByEntityType
methods.description: Retrieves display modes (view or form) for all entity types, with caching.

methods.name: getDisplayModesByEntityType
methods.description: Retrieves display modes for a specific entity type, with fallback to all display modes.

methods.name: getViewModeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for view modes of an entity type.

methods.name: getFormModeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for form modes of an entity type.

methods.name: getViewModeOptionsByBundle
methods.description: Provides view mode options filtered by bundle.

methods.name: getFormModeOptionsByBundle
methods.description: Provides form mode options filtered by bundle.

methods.name: getDisplayModeOptions
methods.description: Generates display mode options with labels.

methods.name: getDisplayModeOptionsByBundle
methods.description: Filters display mode options based on bundle and display status.

methods.name: getViewDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a view display configuration for an entity type and bundle.

methods.name: getFormDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a form display configuration for an entity type and bundle.
